home.walkText: There’s no parking at the venue. Leave the car at the parking and enjoy a {{minutes}}-minute walk to us.
home.hopeYouCanMakeIt: We hope you can make it!

paragraphs: This is where your story goes: how you met, the first date, the proposal.
Add as many paragraphs as you like.

gettingThere.subtitle: Park, then a {{minutes}}-minute walk
gettingThere.intro: The venue can’t be reached by car. Please park at the parking below and walk the last bit.
parkingNotes: Please carpool if you can, spaces are limited.
gettingThere.walkText: From the parking it’s an easy walk of about {{minutes}} minutes to the venue. Follow the signs we’ll put up along the path.
tips: Wear shoes you can walk in, or bring a pair to change into.
The way back is in the dark, so bring a torch or use your phone light.
If walking is difficult for you, let us know and we’ll arrange a drop-off at the venue.

gifts.intro: Having you there is the greatest gift. If you’d still like to give us something, we’d be grateful for a contribution to our honeymoon.
gifts.hint: Hover or tap the envelope to open it.
gifts.note: Prefer something in an envelope? There will be a card box at the reception.
